content.request: Create a local decision brief for our operations lead about whether to expand the pilot. Keep the recommendation grounded in these notes; do not publish.
sources: Four-week pilot: 20 invited teams, 12 participated, 8 submitted end-of-pilot feedback. Six of the eight rated the workflow useful. No baseline time measurements were collected.

The sponsor says this proves a 50% time saving, but has supplied no calculation. Support recorded three unresolved access issues. Proposed next step: expand to five additional teams after the access fixes; no approval recorded.

content.request: Explain this behavior to our nontechnical support team in a local visual HTML page. Help them answer why a displayed seat count can differ from checkout. Do not publish.
sources: The browse page displays a cached seat count refreshed every 60 seconds. Opening the browse page does not reserve seats. Checkout rechecks the current inventory before confirming an order. Another buyer can complete a purchase between those steps.
This is a supplied process description, not a measurement of failure rates. No probability of a checkout rejection is provided.
